full_prompt_en: A square picture-book cartoon places three small dog-like characters in a row across the lower middle of a flat dusty-blue page. They walk toward the right with alternating little feet, their noses projecting in profile and their round black eyes looking ahead. The first has a black head, floppy ear, and orange-red oval body; the middle one is golden yellow with a broad smiling muzzle and several thin spiky hairs; the last is hot pink with an elongated snout, a glossy black nose, and a single loose hair. Their narrow arms and tails are quick black curved strokes, and their feet are simple colored paddle shapes. A rough black-and-white horizontal scuff beneath them is the only ground cue. Nearly all the space above and below the group remains unmarked blue, making the compact procession feel light and funny. The figures are outlined in loose, slightly scratchy black ink with uneven thickness and little stray hatching around the colored shapes. Fill colors look softly rubbed or chalky rather than perfectly flat: orange, yellow, and pink have subtle pale patches and darker edges. White dots in the eyes and noses give just enough shine for expression. There are no shadows, buildings, or decorative background objects; daylight is conveyed by the bright open background and clean color, not by modeled illumination. The visual rhythm comes from repeated rounded bodies and feet with small variations in height, color, and attitude. The whole image feels spontaneous, friendly, and easy for a child to read, like a quick humorous drawing allowed to breathe on the page.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图画书卡通把三只小狗般的角色排在平坦灰蓝页面的中下方。它们朝右走，细小脚步交替，鼻子在侧面突出，圆黑眼睛望向前方。第一只黑头、垂耳，身体是橙红椭圆；中间一只金黄，有宽大的微笑口鼻和数根细而竖起的毛；最后一只亮粉色，嘴鼻拉长，黑鼻头发亮，还翘着一根散乱头发。细窄手臂和尾巴是快速弯曲的黑线，脚是简单的彩色桨片形。脚下一道粗糙黑白横向擦痕是唯一的地面提示。角色上下几乎全部空间都保持空白蓝色，让紧凑队伍显得轻盈好笑。人物轮廓由松散、略有刮擦感的黑墨线勾成，粗细不均，彩色形状边缘有少量零散排线。填色像轻轻摩擦或粉笔涂过，而非完全平滑：橙、黄和粉红有微妙淡斑与较深边缘。眼睛和鼻头的小白点只提供足以传达神情的亮光。没有阴影、建筑或装饰性背景物；白昼感来自明快开放的底色和干净色彩，不依赖塑形光线。视觉节奏来自重复的圆身体与小脚，以及高度、颜色和神态的细微变化。整幅图即兴、友好且容易被儿童读懂，像一幅留有呼吸空间的幽默速写。
style_prompt_en: Loose picture-book ink drawing combines small rounded colored forms with generous flat negative space. Scratchy black outlines vary in thickness and leave occasional stray hatching; warm bright fills have softly rubbed, chalk-like grain instead of smooth vector precision. Dot eyes, tiny white highlights, curved mouth lines, and quick limbs convey expression with minimal marks. A single broken horizontal scuff establishes a ground plane while the larger colored field stays empty. Repeated simple silhouettes create a jaunty rhythm, with slight variations preventing mechanical uniformity. Lighting remains graphic and even, so contrast depends on black linework and lively saturated accents against a calm muted backdrop.
style_prompt_zh: 松散的图画书墨线把小巧圆润的彩色形体与宽裕的平面留白结合。刮擦感黑轮廓粗细变化，偶有散开的短排线；明快暖色填充带轻微粉笔擦涂颗粒，而非平滑矢量精度。点眼睛、细小白高光、弯嘴线与快速画出的肢体用极少笔痕传达表情。一道断续水平擦痕建立地面，其余大片有色底面保持空白。重复的简单剪影形成轻快节奏，细微变化避免机械整齐。照明保持图形化而均匀，对比依靠黑色线条与活泼饱和点色映在柔暗平静背景上。
theme_en: Three cheerful cartoon dogs walking in a loose line
theme_zh: 三只愉快的卡通小狗松散地排成一列行走
name: Roger Hargreaves
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
